name: Manforce Group Berhad
overview: 今年公司完成从 LEAP Market 转板至 ACE Market 的首次公开募股，发行 79,996,000 股新股。业务板块方面，公告未披露各板块的具体扩张、缩减或合约动态。
overview_en: During the year, the company completed its transfer of listing from the LEAP Market to the ACE Market of Bursa Securities via an initial public offering comprising 79,996,000 new ordinary shares. No specific segment-level expansion, reduction, or contract developments were disclosed in the announcements.
